soar_cef.rule_description: Anomalous logins can be a sign that a user's account credentials have been compromised. If an attacker gains access to a user's credentials, they can log in as that user and gain the same access to systems and data as the legitimate user. Anomalous logins might not always be the result of external actors; they can also indicate malicious or negligent activity by insiders.
